notes.title: Mach Day
notes.content:
Enjoy playing with people from all over the world. 
at our weekly international online event. 
 Join the Revolution! 

 This is the ideal meeting point for new and regular Futbolín Revolution players. 
 Create a room, or enter one already created, and chat with people.
 Show your skill with the ball and try to get some trophies.
